title: Spec Plan Deviation Whitelist Schema
description: Defines the structure for whitelisted deviations between project specifications and implemented sources.

spec_requirement.description: The original requirement text from the specification or plan.

implemented_source.description: The actual source, library, or method used in implementation.

reason.description: Justification for the deviation, including references to availability or constraints.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the deviation was recorded.
